posts.author: jace0420
posts.body:
I am trying to import assets that have I originally made in 16x16 scale. For tilesets, switching the setting in MZ to 16x16 tilesets work great, but as I have very simplistic tilesets the characters walking on the map look too large for the tileset. When I replace the characters with a 16x16 sprite sheet, it becomes impossible to use them. I upscaled my 16x16 sheet to use with the characters but of course they still end up at 48x48 so they look too large for the map. Is there any way to scale down the characters/player on the map to fit to 16x16
I've actually just fixed my issue by putting a $ dollar sign in front of the file name to read as one character. I'm not sure why it wouldn't work with my full tile set but I think it has something to do with rpg maker mz default filetypes. My game does now look incredibly small, and I don't know if there is a way to zoom the camera.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
There are many threads about the different issues you're talking about here, if you take a bit of time to look.
jace0420 said:
When I replace the characters with a 16x16 sprite sheet, it becomes impossible to use them.
Click to expand...
You don't give anywhere near enough information to help you with this. What does "become impossible to use" mean? Character spritesheets in MZ do not have a required size, so if your sheet is correctly formatted per the instructions in Help -> Contents -> Documentation -> Asset Standards, 16x16 will work fine.
jace0420 said:
I've actually just fixed my issue by putting a $ dollar sign in front of the file name to read as one character. I'm not sure why it wouldn't work with my full tile set
Click to expand...
You're talking about two entirely different things. The $ is only for character sheets that are one character rather than eight, and has nothing to do with tiles.
jace0420 said:
I don't know if there is a way to zoom the camera.
Click to expand...
There are many. If you Google it you'll find a handful of camera plugins, such as
MZ - Map Zoom
Important To download use MultiTweaks plugin or scrolldown to the Arthran fix attachment in this thread.  Description This script allows you to show maps with a default zoom. When activated the zoom of the map changes. Specify the map zoom using in the map notetag box the notetag Zoom:X where X...
